# H1 — attestation A/B comparison across configs

- **A** = V1 (attestation OFF), **B** = V2 (attestation ON).
- Cell = `mean ± std` of the network-level series over time, pooled across iterations (`—` = no data / metric absent).
- Bursty queue/shed gauges (num_inflight, dispatch queue, pending txs, shed %) instead report the **peak** (max-over-time, mean of per-iter peaks) — a mean would hide the spike that hits a limit.
- Series are computed exactly as plot.py does (rate/histogram_quantile, per-validator collapse); rate window = 10s.
- 45 config(s), 45 metric(s). Tier-3 flat-zero safety panels dropped (use --all to keep).
